toolchain: stable Rust, unoptimized test profile with debug info disabled
environment: Local Linux VM. /tmp was tmpfs and the workspace test directory was an overlay mount; the backing device was not independently verified.
scope: Deterministic threads hold the maintenance lock or pause a real competing handoff; tests check subsequent reclamation, acknowledged values and a reopened source. Counts derive from the test assertions. These repeated schedules are not exhaustive and do not establish physical power-loss behavior or an independent off-host restore.
